Indian Companies Report Strong Q2 Financial Results

National Securities Depository Limited (NSDL) reported a 10.9% increase in its second-quarter profit, reaching Rs 122.5 crore, with income climbing 34.8%. Central Depository Services Limited (CDSL) saw its profit rise by 24% to ₹173 crore, driven by a 7.5 million growth in demat accounts. Additionally, NTPC announced a 39% jump in its second-quarter net profit to ₹7,030 crore, accompanied by a 21% rise in revenue.
